---
title: "Interactive vs Non-Interactive Shells"
---

# Interactive vs Non-Interactive Shells

Bash operates differently depending on whether it is running interactively (attached to a terminal prompt) or executing a non-interactive automation script:

| Feature | Interactive Shell | Non-Interactive Script |
|---------|-------------------|------------------------|
| `$-` flag string | Contains `i` | Lacks `i` |
| Aliases | Enabled by default | Disabled (must `shopt -s expand_aliases`) |
| Job control (`set -m`) | Enabled | Disabled by default |
| Config files loaded | `~/.bashrc` | Non-login loads `$BASH_ENV` |
| History expansion (`!`) | Enabled | Disabled |

```bash
# Check if running interactively
if [[ $- == *i* ]]; then
    echo "Running interactively"
else
    echo "Running non-interactively in automation"
fi
```
